# CAMP Title: New reward in events, in season and Atom Shop

There are new rewards on the "Adventuring in Appalachia" PTS for Patch 66 in March 2026: **C.A.M.P. Title**. As with the player titles, there are also: **Prefixes**, **Suffixes** and CAMP titles that can be used for **both**.

The CAMP titles can be selected next to the icon on your CAMP and are visible to other players, in contrast to the CAMP names, which you only see yourself.

You can choose a prefix and a suffix CAMP title.

## Default CAMP title

You have these CAMP titles immediately for your CAMPs, regardless of rewards.

*German translations will follow later.*

| **Prefix** | **Suffix** |

## CAMP title as an event & activity reward

Some new titles are only available as event rewards. Smaller events have already been renamed activities on the PTS, and there are also some titles as rewards here. Here you can find out which events and activities can be awarded and which titles can be awarded.

### CAMP titles in events

*Click on a title for event details.*

### CAMP title in activities

*Click on a title for activity details.*

## CAMP title in season 24

Some new CAMP titles will also be available in the next season 24 "Cryptids from Beyond the Cosmos".

## CAMP title in the Atom Shop

And of course there are also CAMP titles that are only available in the Atom Shop. Presumably these will be offered as a bundle with other items, just like the player titles are offered in the Atom Shop.
